method: Claude-written prompt -> design spec (BlenderSource/TownLife09/town09_shapes.py) -> cel-shaded ink sketch by BlenderSource/TownLife09/concept_sketch09.py. No AI image model was available in the cloud session; the prompts can be re-run with an image model.

images.name: 01_front.png
images.title: 正面
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Blender modeling reference for a xianxia (Chinese immortal-cultivation) open-world town, single game asset: 竹簍 (BambooBasket). Design: Tapered woven bamboo back basket with staves, weave bands, wooden rim, two rope straps and herb bundles inside. Scale: Approx. 0.6 x 0.6 x 0.67 m. Style: softly beveled stylized 3D game art matching the existing dondon town (dark cedar timber, blue-grey stone, charcoal tile roofs, restrained jade and ochre accents). View: straight front elevation, camera level, facing the -Y front, orthographic, entire object visible on a neutral warm paper background. No characters, no scenery, no text or lettering, no watermark.
